title: Honda HF 2625 HME Premium Lawn Tractor — 122cm Cut, 688cc V-Twin, Hydrostatic
description_html:
For grounds of up to two acres, the Honda HF 2625 HME brings genuine premium-tier engineering to the lawn-tractor class. At its heart is Honda's 688cc OHC V-twin GXV660 engine, producing 13.8kW and paired with a hydrostatic transmission for smooth, stepless speed control across changing ground.

A wide 122cm (48") twin-blade deck clears large areas in fewer passes, with seven cutting heights from 29mm to 90mm to suit anything from a fine ornamental finish to a longer, more natural cut. The synchronous blade action and Optiflow™ fan-assisted system drive clippings cleanly into the substantial 350-litre collector.

Honda's Versamow™ selective mulching lets you mulch and collect at the same time, returning fine clippings to the lawn as feed while still bagging the rest — useful when conditions change mid-cut. An 8.5-litre tank keeps run-time long between fills.

Covered by Honda's 5-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty. Delivered assembled and tested; where possible we deliver by van with a handover demonstration.

  • Versamow™ selective mulching — mulch and collect simultaneously
  • Optiflow™ fan-assisted collection into a large 350-litre catcher
  • Suitable for grounds up to around two acres

title: Honda HRX 537 HY Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower — 53cm, Hydrostatic, Versamow
description_html:
The Honda HRX 537 HY is a premium self-propelled mower built for medium-to-large lawns — comfortably more than two tennis courts — where a wider cut and effortless drive make a real difference to how long the job takes.

Honda's smooth GCV-series four-stroke engine is matched to a hydrostatic transmission, giving infinitely variable forward speed from a gentle stroll to a brisk walking pace, set exactly to suit you and the terrain.

A 53cm (21") cut and Versamow™ variable mulching let you collect, mulch, or do both at once, while the hard-wearing polymer Polystrong™ deck resists dents and corrosion for a long service life. Roto-Stop® lets you stop the blade while the engine keeps running, so you can clear obstacles or empty the catcher safely.

Covered by Honda's 7-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty.

title: Honda Izy HRG 416 PK Petrol Lawnmower — 41cm, GCVx145, Auto Choke
description_html:
The Honda Izy HRG 416 PK brings Honda reliability to smaller and medium lawns in a light, easy-to-handle push mower. It is powered by Honda's latest Euro-5 GCVx145 four-stroke engine, which improves in-cylinder combustion for dependable running — even on lower-grade fuel.

A new Auto Choke system reads engine temperature and sets the choke for you, so starting is a simple, single-pull affair in any weather. Servicing is easier too, with tool-free air-filter access and a larger fuel filler.

The rounded steel deck is built to last and shaped to optimise airflow, filling the 42-litre grass bag efficiently while shedding clippings cleanly for easy cleaning. Folding handles make storage simple in a crowded shed or garage.

Backed by Honda's 5-year domestic warranty.

title: Honda Miimo HRM1000 Robotic Lawnmower — Up to 1,000m², Bluetooth App Control
description_html:
Hand your lawn over to the Honda Miimo HRM1000 and reclaim your weekends. This compact robotic mower keeps gardens up to 1,000m² trimmed automatically, cutting a little and often for the dense, healthy, even finish that occasional mowing can never match.

Despite its small footprint it is a capable machine, handling slopes up to 25° and navigating obstacles with enhanced bump detection that also keeps running noise low. A sealed, IPX4-rated body shrugs off the British weather day after day.

Control could not be simpler: tap start, stop or home on the clear onboard display, or take command from your phone over Bluetooth with the Mii-Monitor app. A 360° lift sensor stops the blades instantly if the mower is picked up, and a quick 40-minute charge keeps it working through the day.

Supplied boxed; installation of the docking station and boundary set-up is the customer's responsibility. Backed by Honda's warranty.

title: Honda HRH 536 HX Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower — 53cm, Hydrostatic, Cast-Alloy Deck
description_html:
The Honda HRH 536 HX is a professional-grade mower for landscapers and homeowners who simply want the best. It is powered by the proven Honda GXV160 OHV four-stroke engine — an engine with a reputation for starting and running, season after season.

A hydrostatic transmission holds blade speed constant relative to ground speed, so the quality of cut stays consistent whether you slow for an edge or press on across open lawn. Drive is taken through a robust shaft and heavy-duty gearbox rather than a belt, for long-term durability under hard use.

Everything about the build is specified for the long haul: a cast-aluminium deck for strength and corrosion resistance, heavy-gauge handlebar tubing with extra bracing, a front deck guard and cable protectors. Roto-Stop® lets you stop the blade without stopping the engine, and the 83-litre bag keeps emptying stops down.

Covered by Honda's 7-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty.

title: Honda HRH 536 QX Self-Propelled Rear-Roller Petrol Lawnmower — 53cm, Striped Finish
description_html:
The Honda HRH 536 QX takes the professional HRH chassis and adds a rear roller — the detail that gives a lawn those crisp, alternating stripes and lets you mow cleanly right up to a border edge. It is the choice for anyone who wants a formal, striped finish from a machine built to commercial standards.

Power comes from the dependable Honda GXV160 OHV four-stroke engine, driving through a shaft and heavy-duty gearbox for durability that a belt drive cannot match. The high-density cast-alloy deck resists corrosion and stands up to professional workloads.

The build is reinforced throughout — heavy-gauge handlebar tubing with a support bracket, a front deck guard and a cable protector all extend the mower's working life. A 53cm (21") deck makes light work of large lawns, and the rear roller supports the back of the mower for confident edging.

Covered by Honda's 7-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty.

title: Stiga A8 Wire-Free Robotic Lawnmower — Up to 800m², GPS-RTK Navigation
description_html:
The Stiga A8 does away with the single biggest hassle of robotic mowing: the boundary wire. There is no perimeter cable to bury or repair. Instead the A8 navigates by GPS-RTK satellite positioning combined with Stiga's Active Guidance System (AGS), placing itself to within millimetres and covering your lawn methodically rather than at random.

Engineered and built in Italy, it manages gardens up to 800m² across as many as four separate cutting zones. An 18cm cutting deck with four pivoting blades spins at 2,850rpm for a clean cut, with electronic height adjustment from 20mm to 60mm.

Set-up takes minutes through the intuitive STIGA.GO app — define your zones on the map and the A8 does the rest, returning to its dock to charge and resuming automatically. Cutting little and often keeps the grass dense, healthy and finely striped.

Supplied with 2+1 years of connectivity and warranty cover.

title: Stiga A1500 Wire-Free Robotic Lawnmower — Up to 2,500m², GPS-RTK, Multi-Zone
description_html:
The Stiga A1500 is wire-free robotic mowing scaled up for large, complex gardens of up to 2,500m². Like the rest of the range it needs no buried boundary cable — navigation is handled by GPS-RTK satellite positioning and Stiga's Active Guidance System, which learns the garden's satellite map and adapts to obstacles and signal conditions over time.

A high-capacity 5Ah ePower lithium-ion battery delivers two and a half hours of cutting per cycle, completing the whole area in as few as two sessions a day. A 120-minute recharge, plus a memory function that resumes from the exact point it stopped, keeps large lawns covered without supervision.

It handles genuinely complex layouts — up to 10 cutting zones (expandable to 20) and 50 no-go areas (expandable to 100), travelling safely between zones with the blades disengaged. Set-up and control are handled through the STIGA.GO app.

Italian-built and supplied with 2+1 years of connectivity and warranty cover.

title: Honda EU32i Portable Inverter Generator — 3,200W, Bluetooth, Eco-Throttle
description_html:
The Honda EU32i delivers 3,200W of the clean, stable inverter power that sensitive electronics demand — and at just 26.8kg it is the lightest generator in its class, with moulded underside grips for easy two-handed carrying.

Honda's fuel-injected GX130 engine and built-in Eco-Throttle work together to match engine speed to the load, cutting fuel use and noise when full output isn't needed. The result is dependable power for trade, leisure or emergency standby, from a unit quiet enough not to dominate a campsite or work site.

Honda's Bluetooth app adds genuinely useful remote oversight: check fuel level and remaining run-time, adjust the Eco-Throttle setting, perform a remote stop and access maintenance information, all from your phone.

Backed by Honda's warranty.

title: Honda EG4500CL Endurance Petrol Generator — 4.5kW, GX390, D-AVR
description_html:
The Honda EG4500CL is a rugged, framed petrol generator built for sites, workshops and serious standby duty. Its Honda GX390 OHV four-stroke engine delivers a 4.5kW maximum and a steady 4kW continuous output — enough for power tools, appliances and site lighting.

A Digital Automatic Voltage Regulator (D-AVR) keeps the electricity smooth and stable, approaching inverter-grade quality, so it can run more sensitive equipment with confidence. A generous 24-litre tank gives up to around 9.5 hours of run-time at half load, balancing endurance with economy and low emissions.

The tubular steel frame and enhanced anti-vibration mounts protect the unit and keep noise to a manageable 81dB(A) at seven metres. A centralised control panel carries two 16A 115V outlets, a 32A 230V outlet and a fuel gauge for safe, straightforward operation.

Covered by Honda's 5-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty.

title: Honda HRX 476 VY Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower — 48cm, Versamow 4-in-1, Variable Drive
description_html:
The Honda HRX 476 VY packs Honda's flagship mowing technology into a 48cm machine for lawns up to around 1,200m². Its Euro-5 GCVx170 167cc engine is powerful and refined yet up to 2kg lighter than the model it replaces, so the mower is noticeably easier to handle.

The standout feature is Versamow™ 4-in-1: with a single lever you can collect, mulch, rear-discharge, or mulch and collect at the same time — no separate mulch plug to fit or lose. Mulching fine clippings back into the lawn feeds it naturally and means fewer trips to empty the generous 69-litre bag.

Honda's Variable Select Drive lets you set the exact walking pace with a dial on the handlebar for a smooth, cruise-controlled feel, while the Polystrong™ deck resists dents and corrosion and Roto-Stop® stops the blade without stopping the engine.

Covered by Honda's 7-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty.

title: Honda HRX 476 XB Cordless Self-Propelled Lawnmower — 47cm, 36V, Versamow
description_html:
The Honda HRX 476 XB brings HRX-grade cutting and collection to Honda's cordless range — all the performance, none of the petrol, cords or fumes. A 1.8kW brushless motor with low-friction cutting technology drives a clean, powerful cut, while a universal 36V battery system with Thermo-Smart technology manages power and run-time intelligently.

It keeps the features that define the HRX line: Versamow™ variable mulching to switch between mulching and collection, Variable Select Drive to dial in your walking pace, and one-hand cutting-height adjustment across seven levels. The Polystrong™ deck shrugs off dents, UV and corrosion.

With the 6Ah DP3660XA battery it covers lawns up to around 450m² on a charge, and a quiet mode lets you mow early or late without disturbing the neighbours. Just charge and go.

Covered by Honda's 7-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty.

title: Honda Versatool UMC425 Petrol Multi-Tool — 25cc 4-Stroke, 8 Attachments
description_html:
One engine, every job. The Honda Versatool UMC425 is a petrol power unit that drives a whole range of garden attachments, so a single tool replaces a shed full of dedicated machines — saving you money, space and the bother of maintaining several engines.

At its core is Honda's 25cc mini four-stroke GX25T engine: clean, quiet and easy to start, running on plain petrol with no two-stroke mixing. A push-and-click joint locking system swaps attachments securely in seconds, and a D-loop handle on a straight shaft keeps the tool balanced and comfortable in use.

Eight optional attachments (sold separately) cover line trimming, brushcutting, short and long hedge trimming, pruning, edging, cultivating and leaf blowing — build the kit around the jobs your garden actually needs.

Covered by Honda's 5-year domestic / 1-year commercial warranty.

title: Honda Versatool Grass Trimmer & Brushcutter Attachment (SSBCE) — Tap-and-Go Nylon Head
description_html:
The Honda Versatool Grass Trimmer Attachment (SSBCE) turns your Honda Versatool power unit into a capable grass trimmer for overgrown edges, long grass and the awkward spots a mower can't reach. It fits the Versatool system directly, so the engine you already own does the work.

A reinforced nylon cutting head with tap-and-go line feed keeps you trimming without stopping to thread line by hand, while a deep debris guard shields you from clippings and thrown material for safer, more comfortable use. An ergonomic easy-grip loop handle gives the control you need through longer sessions.

Need more cutting power for heavier growth? A separate blade kit (sold separately) converts the head into a brushcutter for brambles and woody weeds — one attachment, two jobs.

A genuine Honda Versatool attachment, built to last.

title: Honda WX10 Portable Petrol Water Pump — 1", 140 L/min, GX25 4-Stroke
description_html:
The Honda WX10 is a light, go-anywhere petrol water pump for fresh-water drainage, irrigation and general washing-down. At just 6.1kg with a carry handle, it is genuinely portable — easy to drop into a boot and carry to wherever the water needs moving.

It is powered by Honda's economical GX25 mini four-stroke engine: easy to start, low on emissions and built to Honda's long-life standards. Through its 1-inch ports it shifts up to 140 litres of fresh water a minute, with a 7-metre suction lift and an impressive 40-metre total head — enough to clear a flooded cellar or boat, or push water a long way uphill.

A clever 360° lubrication system lets the pump run at almost any angle without spilling oil or risking engine damage, and an anti-vibration platform protects the machine and extends its life. It also generates around 3.5 bar — handy for washing down equipment.

Backed by Honda's warranty.

title: Echo CS-4510ES Petrol Chainsaw — 38cm Bar, 45cc, ES-Start
description_html:
The Echo CS-4510ES is a Japanese-engineered, mid-range petrol chainsaw that punches well above its weight for heavy-duty lopping and felling — at home in the garden, on the farm and in professional use alike. Its compact 38cm cutting gear is easy to manage, while the 45cc (3.1hp) two-stroke engine supplies serious cutting power.

Echo's Power Boost Tornado™ combustion technology improves power delivery while reducing emissions and fuel use, and flywheel air pre-cleaning keeps performance strong in dry, dusty conditions. The ES-Start system makes pulling the saw into life noticeably easier.

Safety and comfort are built in: a fast-acting inertia chain brake stops the chain the instant kickback is detected, and six anti-vibration mounts protect the operator's hands over long sessions. An adjustable automatic chain oiler matches oil flow to timber hardness and stops at idle to avoid waste, while at just 5kg the saw stays well-balanced and easy to handle.

Covered by Echo's 5-year domestic / 2-year commercial warranty.
